title: What Would Happen If 1 US Dollar Were Equal to 1 Rupee? Explained
seoTitle: What If 1 Dollar = 1 Rupee? What Would Really Happen
seoDescription: If 1 dollar equalled 1 rupee, imports would get cheap but exports, IT jobs and remittances would collapse. Why the rate isn't a scorecard, with RBI data.
excerpt: Who would win and who would lose at ₹1 to the dollar, why the rupee was never equal to the dollar, how purchasing power changes the picture, and how the RBI actually manages the rupee.
